title: BUZZ-Apple set for market share gains in H2 with new product launch - Canaccord |
text:
BUZZ-Apple set for market share gains in H2 with new product launch - Canaccord Reuters Tuesday September 04, 2018 3:32 AM
Kitco News
Share this article: ** Apple will continue to grow its global share of the premium smartphone market, given strong consumer satisfaction with iPhones, Canaccord analyst Michael Walkley writes in a note ** Walkley raises PT on AAPL by $30 to $250, making it 2nd highest on Wall Street, implying 10 pct upside to stock's last close ** AAPL's ecosystem will contribute to strong ongoing growth for services revenue, with higher margin services revenue growth likely to continue outpacing total company growth - Walkley ** AAPL likely to launch three new iPhones in September with possible lower price points, and greater segmentation could lead to market share gains in H2 2018 and YoY unit growth in 2019 - Walkley ** Walkley, rated 4/5 stars for recommendation accuracy on AAPL by TR StarMine, expects iPhone installed base to exceed 700 mln in 2018 ** Says AAPL's "impressive" installed base will drive strong iPhone replacement sales and earnings, and generate cash flow to fund strong long-term capital returns ** Walkley raises EPS estimates for 2018, 2019; maintains "buy" rating on stock ** Apple's 2018 iPhone launch event expected to take place on Sept. 12 ** The mean rating of 41 analysts covering AAPL is "buy," unchanged from 3 months ago, while the median PT has gone up $20 to $220 - TR data ** AAPL up 34.5 pct YTD vs 20 pct gain of S&P tech index , outpacing the broader S&P 500's 8.52 pct rise (Reporting by Brijesh Patel in Bengaluru) Disclaimer: The views expressed in this article are those of the author and may not reflect those of Kitco Metals Inc.
